node.title: Re^2: How to test for empty hash? (Perl Secret Operators)
node.author: eyepopslikeamosquito
node.doctext:
With all this talk of [doc://scalar], I had to look it up because, despite using Perl heavily for twenty years, I've never actually used it! Which reminded me that I have employed the equivalent "secret" version, namely the infamous inchworm ~~ secret operator ... using it three times in my highest rated node [id://397958] I see. :)

See also:

  • Perl Secret Operators (catonmat)
  • [id://773791] (describes Perl secret operators)
  • [dist://perlsecret] on CPAN by [BooK]
  • [id://959855]
  • [id://437032] - the inchworm ~~ secret operator is mentioned as a standard Perl golfing technique (inventor unknown)
  • [id://392172] - mentions inchworm as an alternative to [doc://scalar]

Note that the inchworm secret operator should not be confused with Perl's experimental [id://1089424|smartmatch] operator.
